name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> name. The '01' is a meaningful domain ID: dispatch index 0x01 of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (xref confirmed from the 2nd table slot 0x51B95; table bytes 0x342B5 sit at offset +4). NOT a Ghidra address residue. Descriptor '__ch1_dialog_with_state' accurately reflects the body (chapter 1 turn-event slot, dialog page 4 shown after party-slot-4 addition which mutates runtime char state) and is consistent with the sibling family handlers 00/02/03 which share the same __ch1_dialog_with_state descriptor. Renaming a single member would break a consistent family without benefit. All 8 callees correctly named (fd2_pan_cursor_and_window, fd2_animate_party_addition_with_appear_effect, fd2_clear_keyboard_buffer, fd2_composite_battle_frame, fd2_cutscene_event_trigger, fd2_clear_all_chars_facing, fd2_display_dialog_scene, __CHK).
purpose: Chapter 1 turn-event slot 1 (turn 4 / phase 0): mid-turn beat that pans the camera, makes party slot 4 join the field with the new-char appearance animation, plays cutscene 3, resets all facings, and shows dialog page 4.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x2C) stack-probe prologue (compiler-injected); EBX pushed/popped (callee-saved, unused). Straight-line, no branch (cyclomatic 1), no RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value used: fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0xB,0x10); fd2_animate_party_addition_with_appear_effect(4) -- party slot 4 joins with appear/explosion effect; fd2_clear_keyboard_buffer(); fd2_composite_battle_frame(1); fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(3); fd2_clear_all_chars_facing(); fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=4, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1). In the original binary the final 4 instructions (PUSH [data_fd2_current_chapter_text @ 0x53A79]; CALL fd2_display_dialog_scene @ 0x15F84; ADD ESP,0x24; POP EBX; RET) form a class-3 shared tail at 0x3430D reused by handlers 02 (page=5) and 03 (page=6) via JMP; the src reproduces it as a plain inline call for Layer-2 equivalence.
